title: adonis dentata subsp. microcarpa
intro: Adonis dentata subsp. microcarpa, commonly known as the small-fruited Adonis, is a plant species within the genus Adonis. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adonis dentata subsp. microcarpa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cytotoxic effects.
